blocks.text: Your editorial of Sept. 10, 2026, states that the DOE imposed a Php 24-billion penalty against Solar Philippines Power Project Holdings Inc., of which only Php 80 million has reportedly been collected, and describes the balance as money “rightly due to the government.” For the record, there is clearly no Php24-Billion or even a Php10-Billion demand letter from DOE to Solar Philippines, nor was there any demand letter for that amount ever addressed to Leandro Leviste. There was a DOE letter sent to Mr. Emmanuel Rubio, President of SP New Energy Corporation (SPNEC), which has been majority‑owned and controlled by MGen since […]...
